A '''droid combat enhancement''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] upgrade designed to add hard-wired tactics into a droid's combat algorithms.

==Behind the scenes==
The droid combat enhancements in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' allowed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] the ability to use different attack powers not normally available to them, including power blast, rapid shot, and sniper shot.
